name: generate_pdf_document
description: Generates a PDF from HTML or Markdown and returns it as base64

content.description: HTML content or Markdown text to render into the PDF

input_format.description: Input format: auto, html, or markdown

theme.description: Document style theme: clean or business

css.description: Optional CSS styles injected into HTML before PDF rendering

filename.description: Optional output filename, for example report.pdf
